The '''Smoking Forest''' was a region of the volcanic [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Its name was derived from the smoke that would billow out of the tree-like rock chimneys present in the area. It would also be an area claimed by the [[Blackguard (Mustafar)/Legends|Blackguard]] due to its position close to their headquarters, the [[Southern Jedi Ruins]].

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Smoking Forest appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TSF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Smoking Forest appeared was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:TSF" />
